messages:
Sam: quick post-sim notes. ran the fairness harness against the latest dedicated-pool admission rewrite. most tenants behaved, but premium tenant 'gamma' occasionally breached soft caps when operator reconciliation lagged.
Priya: breach how far? can you paste a short trace?
Sam: short trace:
```
[2026-03-22T16:05:01Z] control-plane: admit(tenant=gamma, provisional=6)
[2026-03-22T16:05:01Z] control-plane: ack provisional
[2026-03-22T16:05:02Z] operator: reconcile ledger: gamma.balance=-2 (stale view)
[2026-03-22T16:05:02Z] operator: spillover_grant -> applied
[2026-03-22T16:05:03Z] audit: hard-cap-violation: gamma > hard_reservation
```
Lena: so control-plane optimistic admit + eventual operator cap check allowed a snapshot gap. classic time-of-check/time-of-use.
Diego: options we discussed before: 1) make commit path synchronous for tenants with billing tier premium, 2) add short soft-lock lease (50-200ms) that operator respects, 3) stronger operator invariants (reject if ledger view older than X ms).
Nate: sync commit for premium is safest but adds tail latency for their requests. are premium customers okay with slightly higher p99?
Priya: some are. they pay for better predictability, not lower p99 necessarily. we should treat premium as SLA: stronger correctness guarantees.
Sam: implementation sketch: introduce admit_token with expiry_ms encoded. control-plane returns {token, provisional_amount}. operator only applies spillover if token either absent or expired. cheap to check.
Lena: Token model looks neat. less latency than full sync. need audit log entries for token usage. also ensure tokens can't be replayed (include nonce + seq).
Diego: sample token payload we can HMAC with control-plane key:
```
{tenant:gamma, seq:12345, amount:6, exp:1679616302000, nonce: 0xabc}
HMAC(control_plane_key)
```
Priya: add config knobs: admit.token_ttl_ms = 150
admit.premium.sync_commit = false
Nate: also add operator metric: token_miss_count and token_replay_detected. we can alarm on token_miss_rate > 0.1%.
InfraBot: rollout-plan: canary to eng-runtime/stage, group=synthetic-small-tenants + 5 premium probes. CI: green.
Sam: I'll open PR with token encoding + operator checks. also adding audit event: admitted_with_token and token_applied.
Lena: one more tradeoff: tokens shift trust to control-plane keys. need key-rotation plan and key access audit. list owners?
Priya: security: keys in KMS, rotate monthly, rotation script included in PR. add audit doc.
Diego: if token approach looks good in canary, we can keep sync-commit reserved for emergency toggles (config override).
Sam: timeline: PR today, canary tomorrow morning, two-day sim run, then decision.
Priya: cool. @Nate @Lena please review the PR when up.
Nate: 👍 will review.
Lena: +1 pending small comments on replay detection.
Sam: thanks everyone. leaving thread open for follow-ups. :rocket:
